info.title: BunaVision Backend
info.description: Public API for preliminary AI screening of green coffee samples. Results are preliminary model predictions, never an official grade.

post.summary: Create an account (always a regular user; admins are created by an operator)
Exchange email and password for an access token
Analyse a green coffee sample photo
post.description: Runs the full workflow synchronously. 201 for a new assessment. A photo that does not show green coffee is rejected with `IMAGE_NOT_COFFEE` (422) and `error.details.is_coffee == false`; nothing is stored. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe: the same key with the same image returns the original result with 200; the same key with a different image is a 409. A dependency failure after the request was accepted is recorded as a failed assessment and the error response carries its `assessment_id`. Over the hourly quota or while the service is saturated: 429.
